claims.object_text: regulating neuronal excitability and protein synthesis
claims.quote: Potassium channels, particularly the sodium-activated Slo2 (Slack/KCNT1) channels, play a critical role in regulating neuronal excitability and protein synthesis.

claims.object_text: FMRP and CYFIP1 interactions; dysregulated protein translation
claims.quote: molecular mechanisms involving FMRP and CYFIP1 interactions with Slack channels, implicating dysregulated protein translation as a contributor to ID.
